title: 'View Day' is no longer offered in the grid cell context menu
permissions_required: Schedule: Edit to open the menu (spec §14.1).
preconditions: 1. You are signed in on a desktop browser with Schedule: Edit.
2. You are on the Schedule page in week or month view.
expected: 1. The context menu shows only 'Create Event' and 'New Work Order'.
2. There is no 'View Day' item - it was removed from the menu.
design_ref: Claude design (authoritative, Branko Q0): build/schedule/spec-v1-2026-07-22/design-notes-claude.md (prototype Schedule.dc.html). spec_1 added the Design link to the doc.
notes: 'View Day' was removed from the cell context menu (menu redesigned to 'Create Event' + 'New Work Order'). Design + Jira SV-8700 agree (DESIGN-RECONCILIATION #9). Driver: SV-8700 §7. Confirm live at VIU.
